regions.merged_text: Our gratitude extends to them and to all those who are now helping to make this benefit party a success. We are deeply appreciative of all they have done for us, and, in return, assure you that you are remembered in all the prayers and good works of our numerous brethren. It is our sincere hope that this harmony of interest and action may never be broken. Our community is at the service of those who may re- quire it; and as long as we are among you here at Detroit we will have the needs of the poor at heart and will relieve their misery as best we can. Once more, let me thank you my brethren, one and all, in the name of our Capuchin community. May mutual appreciation be the soul of our relation- ship in the future as this party in the Armory tonight seems to prove it has been in the past.
